speaker: Townsperson
original_en:
The desert has ripped away at our grass,
and the cow's milk has been sour recently. <PART>
---
It's time I considered leaving Kalstad
for greener pastures elsewhere.
original_jp: 最近砂〓がひどくてさ また〓草地〓が減ったよそのせいか家〓の〓の出も悪くなったし <PART> そろそろカルスタッドを出て別の街への〓住を考える時期かなあ

speaker: Townsperson
original_en:
For generations my family has lived here,
but no more. It was never this bad before.
original_jp: 先〓代々この街に住んできたけど もう限界だよ昔は砂も少なくて住みやすかったって聞くけど…

speaker: Boy
original_en:
This town was once very affluent <PART> ---- <PART> we even
managed to hold Crell Monferaigne at bay! <PART>
---
But the seasonal winds changed, blowing
the desert sands right on top of us. <PART>
---
Now it's a matter of counting the days
until the desert swallows us whole.
original_jp: この街は 昔はもっともっと〓かだったんだってさそれこそクレルモンフェランを撃退するくらいにね <PART> けど 〓〓風の流れが変わったせいで砂漠地〓の砂が流れ込むようになって… <PART> 今じゃ いつ砂に〓まれるかを数える日々ってとこなんだ

speaker: Boy
original_en:
There are tales of heroes who once protected
this town from Crell Monferaigne's invasion. <PART>
---
The swordstress Rasheeka, archer Arcana,
and one other. <PART>
---
The other's name wasn't passed down, so it
must've been a pretty boring person...
original_jp: この街にはさ クレルモンフェランの〓攻から街を守った〓雄がいたんだ <PART> 戦士ラシーカと弓闘士アルカナあと一人居たらしいけど… <PART> 名前は伝わってないんだよねよっぱど印〓が〓かったのかなあ

speaker: Girl
original_en:
Dipan and Crell Monferaigne have
giant castles, don't they? <PART>
---
I bet they have princesses with beautiful
dresses and not a care in the world...
original_jp: ディパンとかクレルモンフェランって凄いお城があるんでしょう？ <PART> きっとドレスを着た素敵なお姫様が住んでるのね〓みなんか一つもないんだろうな…〓ましい

speaker: Girl
original_en:
Dipan doesn't have a princess now, you know.
Maybe they'll accept me as a replacement!
original_jp: ディパンって 今お姫様いないんでしょ？だったら私を代わりにしてくれないかなぁ

speaker: Boy
original_en:
Ma told me to graze the cattle, but the
pasture's too far away. What a pain. <PART>
---
Pa's useless. He's just sweeping sand.
I'm the only one who works around here!
original_jp: 母ちゃんに放〓に行けって言われたんだけどさ〓草地〓は遠いから面倒なんだよね <PART> 父ちゃんは役にも立たない砂〓きばっかしてるし真面目に働いてんのオレだけだよ

speaker: Boy
original_en:
You look like you're pretty well off,
so how about sparing a guy some change?
original_jp: なあ姉ちゃん あんた身なりが良いなこの哀れな少年に小〓いやる気はない？

speaker: Boy
original_en: Why do you have to be so cheap?
original_jp: ちぇっ ケチくせーな！

original_en: Handed over  OTH
original_jp: 10 OTHを渡した

speaker: Boy
original_en:
Sweet! Someday I'll pay you back for this.
Oh, I know when! The end of the world! Haha...
original_jp: へへ ありがとな 貫った分のお礼はいつかするぜそうだなあ… 世界の最後になった時…なんてな

speaker: Boy
original_en: What's the deal? Are you poor or something?
original_jp: なんだよ 金持ってねえじゃん…

speaker: Boy
original_en:
An adventurer told me monsters had come
out of the woods near Coriander. <PART>
---
But to be honest with you, I don't
have a clue where Coriander is...
original_jp: コリアンドル村の近くで魔物が出たんだってね〓〓者の人が言ってたよ <PART> …って言っても コリアンドル村ってどこにあるか知らないけどね

speaker: Boy
original_en:
Villnore once had a thieves guild. Is that
what they call a "necessary evil for growth"?
original_jp: ヴィルノアって 昔は盗賊ぎルドがあったんだって街の発〓のための必要悪ってやつかな？

speaker: Girl
original_en:
Crell Monferaigne's territory lies beyond
the east desert. They're strict over there!
original_jp: 〓の砂漠を〓えればクレルモンフェラン領よあそこはお〓い国だから 気をつけてね

speaker: Girl
original_en:
I'd like to visit Crell Monferaigne, but
they don't allow people dressed like me!
original_jp: クレルモンフェランに行ってはみたいけどこの身なりじゃ追い出されちゃうね…

speaker: Boy
original_en:
My mother is a fortune teller, but
she never says anything significant. <PART>
---
You'll find her in a house on the east edge of
town. Drop by sometime.
original_jp: オレの母ちゃん 占い師なんだけどロクな事を言わないんだよね <PART> 街の〓端に家あるだろ？ そこに居るから興味あるなら行ってみれば？

speaker: Townsperson
original_en:
Something heavy is in the air...unusual.
I've got a bad feeling about this...
original_jp: 空気が重いね いつもと違う…何だか嫌な〓感がするよ…

speaker: Townsperson
original_en:
...A shadow of misfortune looms over you.
Whatever happens, stay alert!
original_jp: …アンタに不〓な影が見えるんだ何が起こってもしっかりするんだよ

speaker: Townsperson
original_en:
The northern sky seems slightly brighter.
I've never seen anything like it...
original_jp: 〓の方の空が 妙に明るいんだよなこんな事今まで一度も無かったけど…

speaker: Townsperson
original_en:
Something's spooking the livestock all of
a sudden, but I don't know what...
original_jp: 急に家〓達が〓えだしたんだ何が〓因だかわからなくて…

speaker: Boy
original_en:
Ma sensed something bad, and it upset her.
I guess it's a fortune teller's hunch.
original_jp: 母ちゃんが 嫌な〓感がするって騒いでんだよ占い師の〓ってヤツかな？

speaker: Girl
original_en:
There is an inordinate number of people
going by today, making my work harder. <PART>
---
If only I were a princess, I wouldn't
even have to lift a finger!
original_jp: 今日は人の通りが変に激しいのおかげで仕事が〓えちゃった <PART> あ～あ お姫様だったら働かなくてすむのかなあ…

speaker: Girl
original_en:
How I long for the sweet life in Dipan!
If only someone would whisk me there...
original_jp: あ～あ ディパンに行って優〓な暮らしがしたい誰か今すぐ連れてってくれないかなァ

speaker: Boy
original_en:
Travelers are up in arms over Dipan being
decimated. The gods' wrath is to be feared.
original_jp: ディパンが滅んだって 旅人が大騒ぎしてたよ神様の怒りって 本当に怖いんだね…

speaker: Boy
original_en:
Now I see the gods' wrath is fearsome,
but do their blessings really exist?
original_jp: 神様の怒りが凄いのはわかったけどさじゃあ 神の恵みってあるのかな…？

speaker: Boy
original_en:
Some think there will be a war now.
Just what I've been training for! <PART>
---
...Oh, I'm not going to fight <PART> ---- <PART> I'll take
a support role or something.
original_jp: これから戦が起きるかもしれないんだってなよおっし！ これで〓行の成果が役に立つかも <PART> あ 別にオレが戦うわけじゃないよそのサ〓ートと言うか何と言うか…へへ…

speaker: Townsperson
original_en:
Rumors of militarization in Villnore, and
talk of war in Crell Monferaigne... <PART>
---
Which will emerge victorious?
Perhaps I'll wager on it...
original_jp: ヴィルノアでは軍事化の噂がクレルモンフェランでは戦争の噂があるらしいね <PART> 次はどこの国が〓権を〓るのかな〓けでもしてみるか…

speaker: Townsperson
original_en:
I'd heard of King Barbarossa. If he's so
great, why was his country destroyed?
original_jp: バルバロッサ王の名前くらいは聞いた事あるが国を滅ぼしたのなら 名〓ならぬ迷〓だよな

speaker: Girl
original_en:
The queen of Dipan followed the king
to the grave, they say. <PART>
---
Isn't it romantic? It's a love story!
That's what true love must feel like.
original_jp: ディパンの王妃様って 王様の後を追って亡くなったんだって <PART> 素敵よね どこかのお話みたい！やっぱり愛し合う二人はこうでなくちゃね！

speaker: Girl
original_en:
The country that challenged the gods fell to
them in one night. It's like a fairy tale!
original_jp: 神に挑んだ国が その怒りにより滅ぼされ一〓にして廃〓と化す… お〓話みたいよね！

speaker: Boy
original_en:
If only I'd had a little more money,
I'd have made this and that...
original_jp: はあ… もう少しお金があればなあ…あれやそれやあんなのも作れたんだけど…

speaker: Boy
original_en:
Hey, it's the girl who gave me money!
Thanks for that! It helped a lot. <PART>
---
I'm actually training to be a blacksmith.
The money you gave me went to materials. <PART>
---
Please take this in return. Think of it
as a future blacksmith's handiwork. Haha...
original_jp: あ 金くれた姉ちゃんだ！あの時はありがとな！ 木ント助かった <PART> 実はオレ 〓〓を目指しててさ貫った金で材料集めてたんだ <PART> でさ 良ければコレ貫ってくんない？未来の名〓の作品って事で…へへ…

speaker: Boy
original_en:
When I develop my skills, I'll
make you an even better one!
original_jp: もっと腕を磨いて もっといいヤツ作ってみせるからな！

original_en:
I think Crell Monferaigne will be next
to win supremacy over the continent. <PART>
---
Their military seems the most organized,
and their people are accustomed to war.
original_jp: 次に大陸の〓権を〓るのはクレルモンフェランだと思うな <PART> 何せあそこは軍備が〓っているしね国民も闘う事に〓れてるし

speaker: Townsperson
original_en:
I'd better mosey over to another village
before the desert swallows this town...
original_jp: この街が砂に〓まれる前に近〓の村に〓るかな…

speaker: Boy
original_en:
I hear that war is going to break out,
but can't believe it will really happen.
original_jp: 戦争が起きるかもしれないって言われても実感が〓かないんだよね

speaker: Boy
original_en:
What will the war bring? The mercenaries
who were here seemed happy to find work...
original_jp: 戦争が起きたらどうなるのかな 街に来てた傭兵は〓ぎ先が見つかるって喜んでたけど

speaker: Girl
original_en:
The upper classes never have to fight
in a war, you know what I mean? <PART>
---
That's the world they were born into...
I just wish I wasn't born here.
original_jp: 戦争になったって どうせ〓い人達は戦わないんでしょう？ <PART> やっぱり 生まれが違うって事なのかなあ～あ こんな街で損したなァ

speaker: Girl
original_en:
They're hiring mercenaries in Villnore.
How much do you reckon a mercenary makes?
original_jp: 今 ヴィルノアでは傭兵を集めているんだって傭兵ってお金〓げるのかな？
